name: Qwen3.5-4B q4f16_1, OpenAI-compatible chat
summary: Qwen3.5-4B quantized to q4f16_1 for WebLLM/WebGPU. Entries preserve the OpenAI-compatible chat contract while tuning runtime and model-library artifacts for a specific browser/GPU configuration.

source.precision: q4f16_1 weights, float16 activations and KV cache

request.tools: Optional OpenAI-compatible tool declarations; they disable the catalog's exact-greedy fast path when they install a grammar or logit processor.
request.stream: Boolean. Streaming chunks follow WebLLM's OpenAI-compatible delta shape.

response.text: choices[0].message.content for non-streaming, or concatenated choices[0].delta.content for streaming.
response.usage: OpenAI-compatible prompt/completion token counts plus WebLLM latency fields when enabled.

generation.fastPath: Exact greedy GPU-resident decode (burst 1 with one speculative GPU lookahead step) only when temperature is zero and no logprobs, penalties, grammar, logit bias, structured output, or custom logit processor is active.
generation.fallback: All other requests use the normal WebLLM one-token sampler and keep the same API contract.

verification.case: Six rotating fresh LaTeX prompts plus four math/prose/code/low-margin quality prompts.
verification.bar: Six of six fresh prompts are byte-identical to the published subgroup-32 path, with equal completion-token counts. Four of four quality prompts are byte-identical to local K=1 full-vocabulary argmax.

notes: Weights and tokenizer remain in the immutable upstream MLC repository. The catalog entry carries metadata plus verified runtime JS and model-library WASM references. Qwen3.5 is a GatedDeltaNet hybrid (1-in-4 layers ordinary GQA, the rest recurrent linear attention holding an RNNState); the runtime's `model.config.overrides.max_history_size` override lets exact-greedy bursts and lookahead roll back that recurrent state on a step that overshoots EOS. Unlike the 8B and Qwen3.5-0.8B rungs, GPU lookahead was measured and adopted for this model (1.103x over the best plain burst, see the report).
